name: Norn's Decree
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls deal combat damage to you, that opponent gets a poison counter.
Whenever a player attacks, if one or more players being attacked are poisoned, the attacking player draws a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a player attacks, if one or more players being attacked are poisoned, the attacking player draws a card.

needs.what: a player-spec binding on the `you_attack` (ATTACKERS_DECLARED) trigger naming the players being attacked directly (not via a planeswalker or battle), so an intervening-if can read `{"cmp": ">", "left": {"max_poison_of": {"binding": "attacked_players"}}, "right": {"const": 0}}` and the trigger fires once per declaration with `controller: "any"` and draws for `event_player`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `combat.declare_attackers` puts `defenders` on ATTACKERS_DECLARED but `triggers.EVENT_BINDING_KEYS` does not carry it into bindings, so no condition can name the attacked seats; `max_poison_of` over `each_opponent`/`each_player` asks about the trigger controller's opponents or the whole table, not the defenders; `creatures_attack_player` with `defending` binds one `defender` but fires once per defending seat, drawing two cards when two poisoned players are attacked, and it also counts seats attacked only through a planeswalker
